purpose: Confirm that the pinned upstream self-check can run in its declared MiniGrid domain and preserve its stdout/stderr, dependency versions, and source revision.
interpretation_boundary: This is an exploratory upstream-code execution, not a reproduction of paper metrics.
The shared and no-share executions have stochastic retries; their pass/fail outcomes are not a causal comparison.
No result transfers to SO-101, MuJoCo, cameras, physical hardware, or First-Robots control.
